BrochureContent.Content:
Dillon Prendiville Auctioneers are delighted to present to the market this charming 4-bed detached family home at St. Brendan’s Terrace, Listowel.  The property is ready for immediate occupation and will appeal to anyone who wants immediate access to the town centre.  The two storey property extends to 115sqm and has a single storey flat-roof extension to the rear.   Designed for effortless living, the home sits on a low-maintenance site featuring an exceptionally large open plan front driveway with ample off-street parking for up to three cars. Furthermore there is secure gated vehicle access to a fully enclosed private rear courtyard, offering a safe haven for children, pets and outdoor entertaining. The energy efficient home boasts complete external Cosi-Wrap insulation and double-glazed PVC windows throughout to ensure year-round warmth and comfort. 

Location is everything, and this home places you at the centre of Listowel's vibrant community. A short, gentle stroll brings you to excellent local schools, boutique shops, essential medical facilities, and the scenic Listowel Town Park and Greenway. For commuters, the property provides immediate, direct access to the Listowel bypass, offering seamless and rapid connectivity to both Tralee and Limerick.  Please call Dillon Prendiville Auctioneers to arrange a viewing on 068 21739.
